Lemma
[Asymptotically cylindrical] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0076 ↗ lem:chow-iv-width-not-euclidean 1. ch28:28.43\group Finite Width

For any basepoints tending to infinity, a finite-width ancient positive-curvature surface subconverges to a static flat cylinder.
